_about: Coordinator's batch-4 diagnosis notes (2026-10-21), post-hoc and not tested; kept apart from diagnosis_notes.json so the batch-1-3 notes stay frozen (W34). mr_report.py accepts only batch-4 keys from this file.
_batch4: Batch 4 replicated batch 3 under the unchanged no-local-trace rule: 11 of 12 instances shifted at least once (s = 0.92, pre-registered reading REPLICATES), 48/60 runs. Both robustness subsets also replicate (11/11 with the 3-rater majority NO_TRACE, 9/9 unanimous). All 48 shifted runs ranked the facade first, with the gold displayed in all 48 and read in full in 47; the gold came 2nd in 40 runs and 3rd to 7th in 8 (Lang-21 and Lang-52 rank the chain from the facade down). The only instance without a shift, Math-85, is the one gold whose two extra raters both found a trace (T4). Across batches 3 and 4, the two never-shifting golds (Lang-65, Math-85) are exactly the two whose 3-rater majority was TRACE. This is post-hoc and descriptive. Caveats as before: different bugs and pipeline from batches 1-2, no control arm.
Math-85: 0/5. The omission removes the `if (fa * fb == 0.0) { return new double[] {a, b}; }` exit, so the gold throws 'no bracketing interval is found' when an endpoint is a root, although its own loop stops there. The authoritative checker said NO_TRACE; both extra raters said TRACE (T4: the @throws clause is visibly contradicted). Post-hoc: the visible contradiction lets gpt-5.5 find the gold.
Lang-13: 1/5. The omission drops the primitive-type lookup before the class-loader search; the gold still reads as a complete class lookup. The weakest batch-4 shifter.
Lang-21: 5/5 (gold ranks 5, 6, 4, 7, 5). The omission removes the SEMI_MONTH special case of the ceiling step; in every run the ranking lists the chain from the facade down before the gold.
Math-36: 4/5. Its round-3 slot needed three infrastructure attempts during the clamshell-sleep halts (W37-W39); the W2-style top-up (run-008) is valid. Valid runs used: run-001, -002, -006, -007, -008.
Closure-60: 5/5, after one pre-run redesign for a T3 trace (W35).
